<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barstate(f):
    # find b and S nodes in base region (rows 30-40, cols 25-36)
    bs={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and 30<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=40 and 25<=n['boundary'][0][1]<=36:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][-1]
            bs[n['color']]=(r0,c0,n['pixels'])
    # determine split: if b and S have same row range -> vertical split; same col range -> horizontal
    if 'b' in bs and 'S' in bs:
        b=bs['b']; S=bs['S']
        same_row = (b[0]==S[0])
        same_col = (b[1]==S[1])
        if same_row and not same_col:
            orient='V'  # vertical split (side by side)
            left = 'b' if b[1]<S[1] else 'S'
            split=f'{left}-left'
        elif same_col and not same_row:
            orient='H'  # horizontal split (stacked)
            top = 'b' if b[0]<S[0] else 'S'
            split=f'{top}-top'
        else:
            orient='?'; split=f'b{b} S{S}'
        pos=(min(b[0],S[0]),min(b[1],S[1]))
    else:
        orient='?'; split='?'; pos=None
    return (pos,orient,split)
print('start:', barstate(current_frame))
for a in ['UP','LEFT','UP','RIGHT']:
    action([a])
    print('after',a,':', barstate(current_frame), 'level:', last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def barstate(f):
    # find b and S nodes in base region (rows 30-40, cols 25-36)
    bs={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and 30<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=40 and 25<=n['boundary'][0][1]<=36:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][-1]
            bs[n['color']]=(r0,c0,n['pixels'])
    # determine split: if b and S have same row range -> vertical split; same col range -> horizontal
    if 'b' in bs and 'S' in bs:
        b=bs['b']; S=bs['S']
        same_row = (b[0]==S[0])
        same_col = (b[1]==S[1])
        if same_row and not same_col:
            orient='V'  # vertical split (side by side)
            left = 'b' if b[1]<S[1] else 'S'
            split=f'{left}-left'
        elif same_col and not same_row:
            orient='H'  # horizontal split (stacked)
            top = 'b' if b[0]<S[0] else 'S'
            split=f'{top}-top'
        else:
            orient='?'; split=f'b{b} S{S}'
        pos=(min(b[0],S[0]),min(b[1],S[1]))
    else:
        orient='?'; split='?'; pos=None
    return (pos,orient,split)
